target.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, 'Fleet rollout ' || status AS text, 'rollout' AS tags FROM grafana_fleet_rollouts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 200

SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS time, 'Edge artifact published: ' || kind AS text, 'artifact' AS tags FROM grafana_edge_artifacts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, kind ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200
SELECT created_at AS time, 'Cache purge ' || type AS text, 'purge' AS tags FROM grafana_cache_purges WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 200

SELECT created_at AS time, action AS text, 'settings' AS tags FROM grafana_audit_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND (action LIKE 'settings.%' OR action LIKE 'platform.%') ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 200
SELECT created_at AS time, 'Emergency mode on for ' || target_type AS text, 'emergency' AS tags FROM grafana_emergency_modes WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 200

description: Monthly bandwidth, 95th-percentile bandwidth, requests, and DNS queries per domain, pool, and region, from rollups only.

panels.description: Where the monthly usage report is.

options.content: The monthly usage report (CSV and PDF) is built from these rollups and listed in the administration panel under **Operations → Usage reports**. Its totals equal the tables below for the same range.

panels.title: Reports

panels.description: Bytes sent to clients this month, headers included.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(bytes_sent) AS bytes FROM cdnf.edge_usage_5m WHERE interval_start >= toStartOfMonth(now())

panels.title: Bandwidth this month

panels.description: Bits per second at the 95th percentile of 5-minute intervals this month, all domains together.

targets.rawSql: SELECT quantile(0.95)(bps) AS p95 FROM (SELECT interval_start, 8 * sum(bytes_sent) / 300 AS bps FROM cdnf.edge_usage_5m WHERE interval_start >= toStartOfMonth(now()) GROUP BY interval_start)

panels.title: p95 bandwidth

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(requests), 0) AS requests FROM grafana_usage_rollups WHERE interval_start >= date_trunc('month', now())
SELECT COALESCE(sum(dns_queries), 0) AS queries FROM grafana_usage_rollups WHERE interval_start >= date_trunc('month', now())

panels.description: Bandwidth, 95th-percentile bandwidth, and requests per domain for the selected range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT domain_id, sum(sent) AS bytes, quantile(0.95)(bps) AS p95_bps, sum(reqs) AS request_count FROM (SELECT domain_id, interval_start, sum(bytes_sent) AS sent, sum(requests) AS reqs, 8 * sum(bytes_sent) / 300 AS bps FROM cdnf.edge_usage_5m WHERE $__timeFilter(interval_start) AND $__conditionalAll(domain_id IN (${domain:csv}), $domain) GROUP BY domain_id, interval_start) GROUP BY domain_id ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Usage by domain

panels.description: Bandwidth and requests per region for the selected range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT region, sum(bytes_sent) AS bytes, sum(requests) AS requests FROM cdnf.edge_usage_5m WHERE $__timeFilter(interval_start) AND $__conditionalAll(region IN (${region:singlequote}), $region) GROUP BY region ORDER BY bytes DESC

panels.title: Usage by region

panels.description: Bits per second sent, per PoP, at 5-minute resolution.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(interval_start) AS time, pop, 8 * sum(bytes_sent) / 300 AS bps FROM cdnf.edge_usage_5m WHERE $__timeFilter(interval_start) AND $__conditionalAll(pop IN (${pop:singlequote}), $pop) GROUP BY time, pop ORDER BY time

panels.title: Bandwidth by PoP

panels.description: Bytes sent per month, over the last year.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(interval_start) AS time, sum(bytes_sent) AS bytes FROM cdnf.edge_traffic_daily WHERE interval_start > now() - INTERVAL 12 MONTH AND $__conditionalAll(region IN (${region:singlequote}), $region) AND $__conditionalAll(pop IN (${pop:singlequote}), $pop) AND $__conditionalAll(edge_id IN (${edge:singlequote}), $edge) AND $__conditionalAll(domain_id IN (${domain:csv}), $domain) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Monthly bandwidth

panels.description: Hourly usage rollups kept in the control database, which the monthly report uses.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', interval_start) AS day, sum(requests) AS requests, sum(bytes_out) AS bytes_out, sum(cache_hits) AS cache_hits, sum(dns_queries) AS dns_queries FROM grafana_usage_rollups WHERE interval_start > now() - interval '62 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 62

panels.title: Billing rollups

panels.description: Bytes sent to clients, headers included, per edge host. SQL: SELECT edge_id, sum(bytes_sent) FROM cdnf.edge_volume_hourly WHERE interval_start >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) GROUP BY edge_id

targets.rawSql: SELECT substring(toString(edge_id), 31) AS edge_id_label, sum(bytes_sent) AS bytes FROM cdnf.edge_volume_hourly WHERE interval_start >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND interval_start <= $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(domain_id IN (${domain:csv}), $domain) GROUP BY edge_id_label ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Download by edge

panels.description: Bytes sent to clients per serving cell. SQL: SELECT cell, sum(bytes_sent) FROM cdnf.edge_volume_hourly WHERE interval_start >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) GROUP BY cell

targets.rawSql: SELECT cell AS cell_label, sum(bytes_sent) AS bytes FROM cdnf.edge_volume_hourly WHERE interval_start >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND interval_start <= $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(domain_id IN (${domain:csv}), $domain) GROUP BY cell_label ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Download by cell

panels.description: Bytes sent to clients per domain.

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat('domain ', toString(domain_id)) AS domain_id_label, sum(bytes_sent) AS bytes FROM cdnf.edge_volume_hourly WHERE interval_start >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND interval_start <= $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(domain_id IN (${domain:csv}), $domain) GROUP BY domain_id_label ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Download by domain

panels.description: Bytes sent to clients per client country.

targets.rawSql: SELECT country AS country_label, sum(bytes_sent) AS bytes FROM cdnf.edge_volume_hourly WHERE interval_start >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND interval_start <= $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(domain_id IN (${domain:csv}), $domain) GROUP BY country_label ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Download by country

panels.description: Request bytes received from clients (the request length, headers included) per edge host.

targets.rawSql: SELECT substring(toString(edge_id), 31) AS edge_id_label, sum(bytes_in) AS bytes FROM cdnf.edge_volume_hourly WHERE interval_start >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND interval_start <= $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(domain_id IN (${domain:csv}), $domain) GROUP BY edge_id_label ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Upload by edge

panels.description: Request bytes received from clients per serving cell.

targets.rawSql: SELECT cell AS cell_label, sum(bytes_in) AS bytes FROM cdnf.edge_volume_hourly WHERE interval_start >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND interval_start <= $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(domain_id IN (${domain:csv}), $domain) GROUP BY cell_label ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Upload by cell

panels.description: Request bytes received from clients per domain.

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat('domain ', toString(domain_id)) AS domain_id_label, sum(bytes_in) AS bytes FROM cdnf.edge_volume_hourly WHERE interval_start >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND interval_start <= $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(domain_id IN (${domain:csv}), $domain) GROUP BY domain_id_label ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Upload by domain

panels.description: Request bytes received from clients per client country.

targets.rawSql: SELECT country AS country_label, sum(bytes_in) AS bytes FROM cdnf.edge_volume_hourly WHERE interval_start >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND interval_start <= $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(domain_id IN (${domain:csv}), $domain) GROUP BY country_label ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Upload by country
